positions.title: Software Engineer (Full Stack) Intern
positions.description:
• Utilized both front end JavaScript/React and back end PHP skills to build off of Wayfair's stack library in order to create a carousel component on Wayfair super browse
• Switched team's unit tests to run under Docker and removed any object dependencies by mocking classes in order to create deterministic and robust tests
• Updated pricing logic on Joss & Main super browse to match with Wayfair's pricing logic using a Libra test
• Integrated batch loading using GraphQL on Wayfair's product display page to reduce page load times

positions.title: Mobile Developer Intern
positions.description:
Learned proper bug tracking and project management using the Jira software. 
Honed Java and Swift implementing skills by adding new mobile features and redesigning the UI in different sections of the company’s mobile applications.
Interacted with online database Realm and updated company’s code to their private Cocoapod library.

positions.title: Tutor
positions.description: • Qualified tutor for Algebra, Geometry, Pre-Calculus, Calculus, & AP Physics 1.

positions.title: Library Assistant
positions.description:
• Taught first-time visitors how to browse the library catalog by using Galileo Interconnected Libraries.
• Assisted visitors with locating books within the music library. 
• Performed clerical tasks, such as answering phones, checking in/out material, and re-shelving books.

positions.title: Crew Member
positions.description: • Prepared pizza, answered phone orders, and maintained cleanliness of the store.
